notes.title: End of Playtest + New Demo for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The [b]FEROCIOUS[/b] playtest is ending today, [b]Friday June 6th[/b], and we want to thank every single one of you who jumped in, shared your impressions, reported bugs, and helped us push this adventure forward.

[b]Your feedback has been instrumental[/b]: thanks to your input, we were able to release an update mid-playtest, adding custom keybinds, improvements to the movement, options to the settings (V-Sync, Target Frame Rate, Highlighting Enemy soldiers…) and a couple more. [b]So yeah, thank you![/b]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnIwd2FlbTcxYmdiNmZ5NDRpNjkzanNzbnFzbTlxa2kwb3J5MWlkcSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/A9fjjw5kN0J4WI0eFv/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2][b]New Demo for the Steam Next Fest[/b][/h2]
The playtest might be over, but a new public demo is now live for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and we’re thrilled to share it with you!

If you missed the playtest, don’t worry: the demo includes both [b]Level 2 Crevasse[/b] from the playtest and an entirely new area: [b]Level 3 Lowlands[/b]. Across these two handcrafted chapters, you'll explore dense jungle, navigate ancient ruins, face off against armed enemies, and survive encounters with something far more primal. Whether it’s your first dive into FEROCIOUS or you’re returning for more, the island has plenty of danger and discovery waiting for you.

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExc2lieTJ6OWJjY3Z6dm9zbm9hMXh3N3Vkam55cGtjYW9kNnM3aWZhayZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/QkMqGvr7t4wTOgxTXS/giphy.gif[/img]

We’d love to hear your thoughts, so feel free to share feedback or bug reports on our official Discord. Thanks again for joining us on the journey to [b]bring FEROCIOUS to life![/b]

[url=https://x.com/FerociousGame]Follow us on Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/MzvQcMxAGm]Join the Discord[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1645630/FEROCIOUS/]Wishlist the game[/url]

notes.title: FEROCIOUS Devlog #3.5: Weapon Modifications & Upgrades
notes.content:
Hey everyone, welcome back to FEROCIOUS, with the continuation of last week's devlog on weapons. Today we talk about weapon modifications and upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40662195/06bcfa3712f20fcd899ec633779f8e1f2844da4d.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Weapon Modifications & Upgrades[/b][/h3]

Weapons can be customized in various ways to make them fit your playstyle. Here are some of the options:
[list]
[*] [b]Optics:[/b] Red dots, scopes, and holographic sights to increase precision.
[*] [b]Lasers & Flashlights:[/b] Useful for low-light situations and improving accuracy.
[*] [b]Folding Stocks:[/b] Better control and stability, especially for rifles.
[*] [b]Firemode Selectors:[/b] Some weapons allow for firemode switches, giving you more flexibility during combat.
[*] [b](Planned) Muzzle Brakes:[/b] Reduce recoil, so you can keep your shots more accurate.
[/list]
The game will not have silencers, being stealth not a priority here. Combat will be noisy, messy, and loud, which is the reason you are here hahaha!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40662195/7cf75576116a4b897ff7bc353d02a08add9e9e20.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Weapon Degradation & Maintenance[/b][/h3]
Weapons degrade with every shot fired. If you don’t take care of your gear, you’ll start running into issues like:
[list]
[*] [b]Jamming:[/b] Weapons are more likely to jam the more you use them. Be ready to clear that jam if you want to keep fighting.
[*] [b]Slower Reloads:[/b] Some guns won’t bolt-lock on an empty mag, leading to slower reloads.
[*] [b]Reduced Accuracy:[/b] Over time, your weapon’s shots will start to stray, making it harder to hit your target.
[/list]
To keep your weapons functioning, you'll need to clean them using acidic mushrooms you find around the island.

[h3][b]Acquiring Weapons[/b][/h3]
You can obtain weapons in several ways:
[list]
[*] [b]Buy from the Arms Dealer:[/b] There’s a shady dealer who’ll trade weapons for gold you find on the island.
[*] [b]Loot from Enemies:[/b] Mercenaries drop weapons when you take them down, though they’re often in poor condition.
[*] [b]Find Hidden Weapons:[/b] Some of the best weapons are hidden around the map, including legendary variants with special perks.
[/list]
The game also has hidden, harder to get legendary weapons:
[list]
[*] [b]Golden Desert Eagle:[/b] High damage, beautiful to look at.
[*] [b]Woodland AK: [/b]A rare variant with camo that does exactly what an AK does, but it looks cool doing it.
[*] [b](Planned) Other Legendary Weapons:[/b] These could have unique traits, like not jamming or dealing extra damage with more recoil.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40662195/cf8018d5b40cbdffa2bf1009b83b574eb058270a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Gunfights & Enemy Behavior[/b][/h3]
The combat system in FEROCIOUS is all about dynamic interactions between you, mercenaries, and dinosaurs. You won’t just be shooting; you’ll be reacting to the environment and leveraging it in your favor.
[list]
[*] [b]AI Behavior:[/b] Enemies take cover, call for backup, and even fight back in packs.
[*] [b]Dinosaurs:[/b] They act on instinct and are unpredictable, but if you can use them to your advantage, they’ll fight mercenaries for you.
[*] [b]Environmental Effects: [/b]Explosives and heavy weapons cause ragdoll effects, dismemberment, and destruction that can change the flow of combat.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40662195/04753fcb9d526988ea113561fb94d4c2df1f7d33.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Melee Weapons & Stealth Kills[/b][/h3]
While melee weapons are secondary, some can be thrown, and there’s a stealth mechanic where you can sneak up behind enemies for a quick, silent kill with a knife. It’s not flashy, but effective.

That’s it for now. Let me know what you think, and stay tuned for another devlog soon! See ya!
